Title: Microsoft Entra: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as standalone MFA factors
Summary: Microsoft Entra will recognize Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as standalone MFA factors starting October 2026, allowing users to meet MFA requirements without additional passkeys. No configuration changes are needed, but organizations should update onboarding and documentation accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Entra: Users can register a passkey or passwordless sign-in as their first multifactor authentication method
Summary: Users can now register passkeys or passwordless sign-in as their first multifactor authentication method in Microsoft Entra, removing the prior requirement to register weaker methods first. This change, rolling out in phases from January 2026 to November 2027, aims to simplify adoption of phishing-resistant sign-in.
